Title: Cyrena.Persistence.Core
Summary: Persistence abstraction layer providing the IStore<T> generic repository contract, ICyrenaPersistenceBuilder for DI configuration, the full specification pattern (ISpecification, Specification, And/Or/Not/Identity/All/EntityId), ordering and paging types, and extension methods for convenient querying. Concrete persistence backends (e.g. Cyrena.Persistence.File) implement IStore<T>. Version 0.6.0.
